overview.description: The Northern Trust ESG & Climate Developed Markets ex-US Core ETF (FEDM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund tracks a principles-based index of large-cap companies from the developed markets outside the US that exhibit environmental, social, and corporate governance (ESG) characteristics. FEDM was launched on Sep 20, 2021 and is issued by Northern Trust.
